# Nate documentation

Version: 1.0.0-rc.1 (native compiler and interpreter release candidate).

Native builds use nate build with the system C compiler and bundle imports and the checked runtime. The experimental --backend=nate owns typed IR and ARM64/x86-64 instruction generation for scalars, floats, globals, and guard recovery. The language contracts are authoritative for the native C backend and interpreter. VM/legacy LLVM, async, agents, and other preview APIs are not stable promises. Strings use byte offsets. Imports are unqualified. Channels enqueue; receive blocks.
